isd.text: Innistrad is a plane where humans are prey, and its story begins with Edgar Markov, pushed by the demon Shilgengar, creating vampirism and inflicting it on his grandson Sorin, which awakens Sorin's planeswalker spark.
Sorin later returned and created the archangel Avacyn to safeguard humanity, and she and her angels slaughtered the plane's monsters so fiercely that Sorin's kin branded him a traitor.
Because demons kept returning in new forms, Avacyn decreed that they be bound rather than destroyed, and she took up the silver collar as her symbol.
Then Avacyn vanished, and the effects soon showed: prayers and holy symbols no longer protected villages, the dead stirred more easily, and the Church's power waned.
Into this decline came Liliana, who traveled to Innistrad to hunt her three remaining demon masters.

dka.text: In Dark Ascension, Innistrad is overrun by creatures of the night and humans edge toward extinction, with Avacyn revealed to be locked in the Helvault after Griselbrand turned it against her.
Without their archangel, her angels suffered wounds and had to retreat, while humans lost hope, toppled her statues and joined demonic cults.

Sorin came home to find vampires killing at will and ghouls besieging Thraben, and he lamented that only the shadow of his creation remained, while Liliana and Garruk each arrived on the dark plane with their own hunts.

avr.text: Avacyn Restored tells of the plane's rescue, as Liliana Vess forced Thalia to open the Helvault and Avacyn emerged free from her prison.
Avacyn cleansed the world with divine fire in a wave of spells called the Cursemute, decreeing that werewolves could become the wolfir, allies against darkness.

The Helvault was destroyed, fearful mobs became fearless battalions, and Avacyn set about rallying her troops to cleanse Innistrad of the demons freed along with her, though Thalia noted that her freedom cost Griselbrand's life.

soi.text: In Shadows over Innistrad, Avacyn has finally returned but new evils have come with her, and madness plagues the inhabitants.
The cause was Nahiri, who vowed to take everything from Sorin and who drove Avacyn and most of her angels insane, fragmenting the Church.
The howling of werewolves marked the end of the Cursemute and the beginning of Avacyn's madness, and cathars who had fought shoulder to shoulder were soon at each other's throats.
Jace of the Gatewatch came to investigate the plane's dark mysteries, while Tamiyo warned that the plane had lost its protector.

emn.text: In Eldritch Moon, Nahiri's revenge reaches its peak when she calls to the sky for Emrakul to come to Innistrad, and the plane's final ward falls.
Emrakul twisted plants, animals and sentient beings into Eldrazi Horrors, while Bruna and Gisela were fused into a single angel proclaiming her.
Sorin killed his creation Avacyn, and with her dead Innistrad's last protections faded.
Jace brought the Gatewatch and Liliana brought hordes of undead as unlikely allies, and in the end Jace, Nissa and Tamiyo trapped Emrakul in Innistrad's moon.

mid.text: Innistrad: Midnight Hunt opens on a plane that has turned to older, darker magic in the absence of Avacyn's protection, with Emrakul sealed in the moon.
The populace feared a night that might never end, so humans turned to the Harvesttide festival and a ritual with warlocks to maintain the balance.
Olivia Voldaren disturbed the ritual and took the Moonsilver Key, beginning the Eternal Night, but Arlinn and the Gatewatch recovered the key and the Eternal Night ended.

vow.text: In Crimson Vow, Innistrad faces the Eternal Night and humanity turns to the hope of rituals and a Harvesttide festival to save them.
Olivia Voldaren, the bride at the biggest vampire wedding in Innistrad's history, aims to unite the Markov and Voldaren bloodlines to take control of the plane.
She seized the Moonsilver Key and locked the plane into Eternal Night, but she fled, and the ritual at the Celestus with the restored key ended it.

mh3.text: Innistrad appears in Modern Horizons 3 as the plane Emrakul arrived on, where even fossils answered her twisted call.
